name: Camping 101: First Aid
summary: You are ready to make a bandage pouch, and now you need a place to try it.

sections.title: A Place to Camp
sections.body: You can make the pouch, but most people would rather not camp in the middle of town. So take it out into the wilderness. Before you set up camp, you need a campfire. Most cooks can teach you how to make one.

faq.q: Where can I try the bandage pouch?
faq.answer: Try the bandage pouch in the wilderness, where people are less likely to object to a camp.

faq.q: What do I need before setting up camp?
faq.answer: You need a campfire before you can set up camp.

faq.q: Who can teach me to make a campfire?
faq.answer: Most cooks can teach you how to make a campfire.
